topology.v: per channel (Pc, P_feed, P_mid): bridge excitation = +5V_SNS (ratiometric with the existing 0.5-4.5 V scaling and the comparator references), RFI filter 2 x 1.00 k + 10 nF diff + 2 x 1 nF CM, TI INA333 (zero-drift, rail-to-rail output) on +5V_SNS, gain set by a select-on-test RG, REF from a buffered select-on-test divider of +5V_SNS (OPA2333 dual buffer per two channels), open-wire bias 10 M on each signal line (SIG+ to GND, SIG- to +5V_SNS). INA output = the existing PC_SIG / PFEED_SIG / P_MID_SIG net: divider, anti-alias RC, ADS131M04 and the U330 / U570 comparators are unchanged in topology.

v.equation: V_SIG = V_exc x (0.10 + 0.80 x p_abs / FS) after the select-on-test trims

v.SIG+ open: IN+ pulled to GND -> output at the low rail (0.05 V) < 0.25 V: PC_SENSOR LOW (DERIVED)
v.SIG- open: IN- pulled to +5V_SNS -> output at the low rail: LOW (DERIVED)
v.EXC+ open: both signals fall to ~0 V through the bridge arms; INA333 common-mode limit (V-) + 0.1 V violated: output undefined (MISSING) - may read near zero pressure (not caught by the 0.25 V window). Firmware coverage: the light rule never confirms (no E1/E2: abort with the gate reason); in RUN a step to ~0 bar abs trips PC_BAND. B-PC-1 open-wire row measures it.
v.EXC- open: both signals rise to ~5 V; INA333 CM limit (V+) - 0.1 V violated: output undefined (MISSING); if it reads HIGH the comparator trips (HW_OVERPRESSURE) - the same class as the v2.10 070BG open-ground case. B-PC-1 open-wire row.
v.cable short SIG+ to SIG-: output = REF (reads the trimmed zero ~ 0 bar abs): same coverage as EXC+ open
